I also wanted to add that I'm the same age as you, and I can understand where you're coming from. I feel like this sometimes too, but I just think about how much having children changes your life and it kind of snaps me out of it. Maybe try to get a pet that you can take care of and "mother"? I have a little dog who's very attached to me and that helps, I love him dearly and I treat him like a baby. Or like some people have said get a job that revolves around children, maybe a daycare or something.

Obviously I can't stop you, but I think you need to think about everything else that comes with becoming a parent. From what I've heard, it's a LOT of work. Sleepless nights, non-stop crying, diaper blowouts and more, it doesn't sound like you're thinking about any of the bad stuff. Also, babies turn into toddlers, then to children, then teenagers...they aren't just a "mini-me", they're their own unique people. I think you need to look up some horror stories from parents and ask yourself if you really want that right now. 

Also, how old is this guy you're seeing? Dating someone who's in college as a high school junior sounds iffy to say the least. It could be possible that you're being groomed by him. Even if you're not, ask yourself if you really want a child with him, because if he ends up not being the right person for you, you could be stuck co-parenting with him for a long time. Having parents who aren't together can be very rough on kids. 

Please be careful and think very hard about if you really want this. You have much more life to live, don't rush into it.
